lines.name: Line 4
lines.colourNote: Line 4's colour was changed from Orange to Yellow in 2025 (wiki-line4). CMRL has not published an official hex value; #F2B705 is an approximation.
lines.status: Partially open. Lighthouse–Vadapalani (Kodambakkam Power House section and the underground core) is under construction.

lines.name: Line 2
lines.status: Open. Interchange with Line 4 at Vadapalani.

lines.name: Line 5
lines.status: Under construction. Shares the Arcot Road double-decker with Line 4 (upper deck) between Alapakkam and Alwarthirunagar.

fares.note: Intermediate fares (Rs 20–30) were reported by distance band; CMRL is to publish the full chart after inauguration.

bands.note: CMRL's distance-based fare chart (paper / token fares). Consistent with the published Line 4 range of Rs 10–40 for its 14.64 km; CMRL's own fare page could not be retrieved, so the chart is taken from fare guides that agree with each other.
bands.source: TrackMyMetro — Chennai Metro fare table (https://trackmymetro.com/chennai-metro/); RailTravels — Chennai Metro Rail fare chart (https://railtravels.org/chennai-metro-rail-fare-chart/)

digitalDiscount.appliesTo: Mobile QR tickets (single, return, group, trip passes) via the CMRL app, WhatsApp, Paytm and PhonePe, and the Singara Chennai (NCMC) card. Not paper QR tickets bought at the counter.
digitalDiscount.source: CMRL on X — 'CMRL offers a 20% discount on Metro Travel Card, Mobile QR Code ticketing … and NCMC Card' (https://x.com/cmrlofficial/status/1868879444649074806); DT Next — Singara Chennai card (https://www.dtnext.in/news/chennai/cmrl-introduces-improved-method-of-availing-singara-chennai-card-809423)
